sanskrit_verse: अयोनौ क्रमते यस् तु बहुभिर् वापि वासयेत् । शुल्कम् अष्टगुणं दाप्यो विनयस् तावद् एव च ॥
transliteration: ayonau kramate yaḥ tu bahubhir vāpi vāsayet | śulkam aṣṭaguṇaṃ dāpyo vinayaḥ tāvad eva ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who engages in improper sexual conduct or cohabits with multiple individuals without dharmic sanction shall restore eightfold the value of the disturbance caused and undergo correction until alignment is restored.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Sexual conduct derives its lawful basis solely from dharmic sanction; unauthorized union disrupts cosmic order.
Causation: The act directly generates energetic distortion requiring proportional restitution.
Capacity-based responsibility: The individual retains agency to choose alignment and must therefore bear corrective burden.
Restoration logic: Rebalancing occurs through quantifiable compensation and behavioral recalibration.
Consciousness alignment: Correction serves to realign individual consciousness with universal dharma.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual engages in unsanctioned sexual union OR cohabits with multiple persons THEN compute disturbance value based on societal impact AND require eightfold restitution.
WHILE alignment deviation persists APPLY corrective protocols UNTIL conscious reorientation is verified.
IF restitution is made AND behavioral correction concludes THEN declare completion of dharma-adhikara.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this provision governs adjudication concerning violations of dharmic marital boundaries. The court must assess the quantum of societal disruption caused and mandate restitution accordingly, ensuring that correction focuses on consciousness realignment rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that unsanctioned union creates measurable energetic disturbance. Anupūrvaśaḥ demands sequential correction through proportional restitution. Responsibility aligns with capacity to act consciously. Punishment has no place where dharma itself offers the path of completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate restitution process wherein the offender pays eightfold the assessed disturbance value.
Assign corrective engagement under qualified spiritual supervision until consciousness realignment is confirmed.
Verify integration through declared intent and sustained harmonious behavior post-completion.
Reintegrate the individual into community upon successful fulfillment of dharma-adhikara.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law originates solely from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is hereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
